# Simpson Singing School

> Singing and piano tuition, children’s choirs and adult choirs led by Morag Simpson in Westhill, Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.

Canonical website: https://simpson-singing.school/

## Verified facts

- Teacher: Morag Simpson, MA, LRAM, LTCL, PGCE.
- Experience: More than 40 years teaching music.
- Professional status: GTC registered and PVG checked; member of the Royal Society of Musicians and the Musicians’ Union.
- Individual tuition: Singing and piano, beginner to Grade 8 and beyond, ages 6 to adult, £40 per hour.
- Choir sessions: children’s choirs cost £5 per week; Vox Amabile and Westhill Community Choir cost £6 per week; includes music on loan and room rental.
- Location: Westhill, Aberdeen AB32 6PY, serving Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire.
- Contact: Simpsonmorag@gmail.com; +44 7818 464546.

## Choir schedule from 1 September 2026

- Tuesdays, 7:00–8:15 pm: Westhill Community Choir, Kirkton of Skene Church.
- Thursdays, 6:00–7:00 pm: Musical Midgies children’s choir, Culter Church.
- Thursdays, 7:15–8:15 pm: Vox Amabile adult choir, Culter Church.
- Fridays, 4:30–5:30 pm: Children’s Choir studying Joseph, Westhill.
- Fridays, 5:40–6:40 pm: Cantabile select adult chamber choir, Westhill.
- All groups are working towards a concert planned for 8 or 9 May 2027.
